bio: Eldest child of Benjamin Pringle and Charity Gould of Plymouth, Luzerne Co.; married Caleb Roberts in 1852 and moved to Iowa (children Esther, Alfred, Helen per Giles & Franklin). Died a widow at Verona, Faribault Co., Minnesota, 30 Dec 1897, aged 75y 3m 9d; the register names her parents as Benj. and Charity Pringle, both born Pennsylvania.
